notes: *let none come* divides with the volitive *let* on the jussive verb (rule 17) and *none* on the prohibitive אַל, which is the word carrying the negation (rules 15, 35); the competing reading would give *none* to the verb as an indefinite subject, but a morpheme carrying the negation stands in the clause.

כִּי אִם is fused to *save* under rules 30 and 35 rather than split, since neither morpheme owns a part of that one word; the two explicit הֵמָּה each keep only their own *they*, the copula going to the predicate קֹדֶשׁ under rule 20.
